note: git.head_sha records the audited baseline commit, i.e. the state described by the Phase 0 audit. It is intentionally not updated to the commit that adds this manifest.

data_notes: Model rows require CPCB, INSAT-3D AOD and MERRA-2 to be jointly available on the same day, after a three-day forward fill.
INSAT-3D and MERRA-2 granules held locally cover 2024 only, so the multi-source model is trained and tested within 2024 even though the CPCB record extends back to 2016.
Model configuration 'tuned' selected on the validation window 2024-04-10 to 2024-05-16, which ends before the test window begins; the test set influenced no modelling choice.
The operational forward forecast persists meteorological and satellite inputs from the last observed day as a placeholder for NWP forecast fields; it is not driven by a real weather forecast.
Requested features absent from every local granule and therefore excluded rather than imputed: PBLH.
MERRA-2 variable V10M missing on 2 of 172 days before complete-case filtering.
